title: Floating row cards
description: Each arrival row becomes its own rounded surface-2 card with a gap between rows instead of a continuous list separated by dividers, giving each departure a more distinct, tappable-looking unit.

changes.intent: Stack row-cards with a visible gap instead of an unbroken list.
Give each row its own card surface, rounded corners, and remove the divider since separation is now via the gap and surface contrast.
